title: March for Freedom and Justice in Cuba (Washington, diaspora action)
reason: DIARIO DE CUBA reports an actual march and vigil in Washington, United States, organized by exile groups and directed at Cuban political conditions. The baseline defines this as a home-grown protest dataset and locates actions by event country; this occurred outside Cuba, so it is not coded as a Cuba-unit event. Attendance is unreported, so the ≥50 threshold is also unestablished.
notes: S006 is a pre-event search-only announcement and is not treated as proof or independent corroboration; S004 is the body source for actual occurrence.
open_questions: Does the project assign diaspora protests abroad to the home country when they target its government?
How many people were simultaneously present?
